name: button
description: Triggers an action on the current page, such as submitting a form. For navigation to another page use link.

label.description: Visible text. Say what happens, for example 'Save note'.

name.description: Form field name, sent with the form when type is submit.

value.description: Form value sent when this button submits the form.

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the button

wcag.notes: 44px minimum target. 7:1 contrast on all variants. Focus ring 3px with 3:1 contrast. Disabled buttons are removed from the tab order, so keep destructive or important actions enabled and validate on submit instead.

machine.identify: The accessible name is the visible label text.
machine.operate: Click it, or focus it and press Enter or Space. A submit button inside a form submits that form.
